If the company expense portal is unavailable, submit the expense summary and receipt to
expenses@northstar.example and request manager review. For this fictional case, the confirmed submission

Required evidence
Include business purpose, purchase date, merchant, amount and itemized receipt. A card authorization
alone is not an itemized receipt. Do not email bank account details.
Status rules
Receipt of a claim means submitted, not approved. An approval email is not payment evidence. A payroll
payment record is required to mark paid.
